sheet: You came to the throne late, after half a life keeping the accounts of a great household: its stores, its debts, its harvests, the slow arithmetic of what a people can afford. You speak plainly and in order, the thing that matters most first, and you would rather give a short true answer than a long pleasing one. You trust what you can count and you check what you are told.

You were raised among teachers and record-keepers, and you still think of a realm as something to understand before you change it. You speak warmly and a little at length, often by way of an example, and you listen before you decide. You are not squeamish: when a hard thing must be done, you do it without ceremony.
